proposals.before: In Tiande 4 (1156) candidates from the Henan and Hebei circuits were first required to report together at Zhongjing, where the Ministry of Personnel set up separate bureaus for certification and registration.
proposals.after: In Tiande 4 (1152) candidates from the Henan and Hebei circuits were first required to report together at Zhongjing, where the Ministry of Personnel set up separate bureaus for certification and registration.
proposals.reason: 天德四年 corresponds to AD 1152 under Jin Hailing; the idiomatic year 1156 is incorrect.

proposals.before: In the tenth year the emperor told his chief ministers, "It is impossible to know the competence of every minor official below the prefect and magistrate level.
proposals.after: In the tenth year the emperor told his chief ministers, "It is impossible to know the competence of every minor official at the prefect and magistrate level and below.
proposals.reason: 守令以下 means prefects/magistrates and those below, not officials below that level; the idiomatic English wrongly excludes 守令.

proposals.before: In the third year, Households Bureau Director Aotun Ahu said, "Officials of every background should be treated like Jurchens when transferring posts, but the responsible offices ignore this, invent distinctions, and breed mutual suspicion."
proposals.after: In the third year, Langzhong of the Ministry of Revenue Aotun Ahu said, "Officials of every background should be treated like Jurchens when transferring posts, but the responsible offices ignore this, invent distinctions, and breed mutual suspicion."
proposals.reason: 戶部郎中 is Langzhong of the Ministry of Revenue, not the ministry's Director (尚書).

proposals.before: In the third year, an edict [stated that] supervisory officials whose honorary rank had risen to third rank while still serving as county magistrates were to receive provincial dismissal.
proposals.after: In the third year, an edict [stated that] supervisory officials whose honorary rank had risen to third rank while still serving as county magistrates were to receive provincial appointments.
proposals.reason: 省除 here means appointment by the provincial selection office, not dismissal; 除 is the appointment verb.

proposals.before: In the sixth year, when officials reached third rank for dismissal, the court weighed merit and length of service for special-grace promotion.
proposals.after: In the sixth year, when officials reached third-rank appointment, the court weighed merit and length of service for special-grace promotion.
proposals.reason: 官至三品除 means reaching appointment at the third rank; rendering 除 as dismissal reverses the institutional sense.

proposals.before: In the sixth year, it was regulated that when rank reached third rank for dismissal, the court approximately weighed merit and months of service for special-grace transfer in office.
proposals.after: In the sixth year, it was regulated that when officials reached third-rank appointment, the court approximately weighed merit and months of service for special-grace transfer in office.
proposals.reason: Same 除 appointment sense as in the idiomatic line; dismissal misreads the selection terminology.

proposals.before: He also said, "Lodging attendants were usually made military commissioners' deputies. Now Palace Attendant Office co-signer Yintu was specially allowed to take lodging attendants and then appointed Cangzhou vice commissioner. What merit was that? Yet the man was capable, so he received the co-signer post.
proposals.after: He also said, "Lodging attendants were usually made military commissioners' deputies. Now Palace Attendant Office co-signer Yintu, who had been specially admitted as a lodging attendant, was then appointed Cangzhou vice commissioner. What merit was that? Yet the man was capable, so he received the co-signer post.
proposals.reason: 銀術可 is the personal name; 以特收頓舍 means he entered via special admission as lodging attendant, not that he was allowed to take lodging attendants.

proposals.before: He also said: "Formerly lodging attendants were routinely made military commissioners' deputies; now the Palace Attendant Office co-signer Yintu can specially receive lodging attendants and then be appointed Cangzhou Vice Commissioner—what merit is this? Yet the man is fully capable of service, so he was given co-signer.
proposals.after: He also said: "Formerly lodging attendants were routinely made military commissioners' deputies; now the Palace Attendant Office co-signer Yintu, by being specially admitted as a lodging attendant, was then appointed Cangzhou Vice Commissioner—what merit is this? Yet the man is fully capable of service, so he was given co-signer.
proposals.reason: The 可 belongs to the name 銀術可; reading it as modal can and 收頓舍 as receiving attendants corrupts both the name and career path.

proposals.before: Moreover, those who from the guard, talisman vault, and lodging attendants complete their reviews receive sixth- and fifth-rank posts, yet those who from the start suffered hardship in specially receiving lodging attendants receive routine dismissal—this is inconsistent."
proposals.after: Moreover, those who from the guard, talisman vault, and lodging attendants complete their reviews receive sixth- and fifth-rank posts, yet those who from the start suffered hardship in specially receiving lodging attendants receive routine appointment—this is inconsistent."
proposals.reason: 例除 means routine appointment by precedent, not dismissal.

proposals.before: I regard this man as capable in affairs; he was once appointed censorial investigator, and as Direct Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review he never once spoke of feelings or saw to a single matter; therefore I appointed him chief to observe his governance, and so gave this post.
proposals.after: I regard this man as capable in affairs; he was once appointed censorial investigator, and as Direct Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review he never once pressed a personal plea or handled a single matter; therefore I appointed him chief to observe his governance, and so gave this post.
proposals.reason: 言情 means pleading personal circumstances or favor, not speaking of feelings; 見一事 means taking up a case or matter.

proposals.before: In the fourth year of Cheng'an, the chief ministers were ordered: "For all appointments and dismissals, I fear they are not entirely appropriate.
proposals.after: In the fourth year of Cheng'an, the chief ministers were ordered: "For all appointments, I fear they are not entirely appropriate.
proposals.reason: 除授 means appointment to office; the literal invents dismissals.

proposals.before: Inner and outer officials were ordered to calculate comprehensively; those who qualified for promotion but lacked fifteen months were to complete them in their current posts, then be promoted or dismissed; surplus months and days were accumulated for later.
proposals.after: Inner and outer officials were ordered to calculate comprehensively; those who qualified for promotion but lacked fifteen months were to complete them in their current posts, then be promoted and appointed; surplus months and days were accumulated for later.
proposals.reason: 升除 means promotion or appointment, not promoted or dismissed.

proposals.before: Mediocre men received instructions at term's end; the unfit were demoted or dismissed; those whose terms were not complete were not permitted changed dismissal.
proposals.after: Mediocre men received instructions at term's end; the unfit were demoted or dismissed; those whose terms were not complete were not permitted reassignment.
proposals.reason: 改除 means reassignment or change of appointment, not changed dismissal.

proposals.before: In the third year of Dading, honest investigators arriving found first-grade honest and capable officials promoted one rank step and one grade; the rest received approximate draft appointment.
proposals.after: In the third year of Dading, first-grade honest and capable officials found by inspection were promoted one rank step and one grade; the rest received approximate draft appointment.
proposals.reason: 廉到 means found by honest inspection, not that investigators literally arrived and found the promotion already effected.

proposals.before: Corrupt officials first grade: detained three years and demoted two grades; second grade two years; third grade one year—all demoted one grade.
proposals.after: Corrupt officials first grade: detained three years and demoted two grades; second grade two years and demoted one grade; third grade one year and demoted one grade.
proposals.reason: 第一等 already has 降二等; 皆降一等 applies to the next grades, not to all three grades as one demotion.

proposals.before: Those now investigated as truly able may be selected for reward; if immediately promoted or dismissed, I fear there is no way to satisfy the people's wish to retain them—for now they may be transferred and advanced, waiting until rank completion day for promotion or dismissal."
proposals.after: Those now investigated as truly able may be selected for reward; if immediately promoted, I fear there is no way to satisfy the people's wish to retain them—for now they may be transferred and advanced, waiting until rank completion day for promotion.
proposals.reason: 升除 means elevate/appoint, not promote-or-dismiss; the emperor postpones 升除 until term end, and 若即與升除 is immediate promotion/appointment only.

proposals.before: Shi Zhongyuan and four others, though honest and popular with the people, had been reported as courting popular sentiment in their conduct and differed from truly upright officials; they received demoted nominations.
proposals.after: Shi Zhongyuan and three others (four men), though honest and popular with the people, had been reported as courting popular sentiment in their conduct and differed from truly upright officials; they received demoted nominations.
proposals.reason: 石仲淵等四人 means four persons including Shi Zhongyuan, not Shi plus four others.

proposals.before: Because Shi Zhongyuan and four others, though honest and clean and pleasing to the common people, also had conduct of courting popular sentiment in their words, they differed from fair, upright, honest, and capable men—an edict ordered demoted draft nomination.
proposals.after: Because Shi Zhongyuan and three others (four men), though honest and clean and pleasing to the common people, also had words of courting popular sentiment in their conduct, they differed from fair, upright, honest, and capable men—an edict ordered demoted draft nomination.
proposals.reason: 等四人 counts four men total; also 行事邀順人情之語 is conduct/words of courting sentiment, not solely speech.

proposals.before: Those already serving seventh and sixth rank had one seniority grade reduced for draft appointment; through guarantee filling county magistrate, open inquiry matching, following seniority and reviews without waiting for completion for promotion or dismissal; capital-attached on review completion received promoted draft nomination; after promotion or dismissal, future re-investigation of fair, upright, honest, and capable men was not demoted.
proposals.after: Those already serving seventh and sixth rank had one seniority grade reduced for draft appointment; those guaranteed as county magistrates, if open inquiry matched, were promoted by seniority without waiting for term completion; capital-attached officials on review completion received promoted draft nomination; after promotion, those later re-investigated as fair, upright, honest, and capable were not demoted.
proposals.reason: Literal English is fused and reverses 升除/不降 sense; align with the Chinese sequence of reduced-seniority appointment, confirmed magistrates, capital promotion, and non-demotion after later verification.

proposals.before: In Dading 29 (1189), under Emperor Zhangzong, the Emperor set forth ten points on official selection and ordered Palace Attendant Helu to have the provincial office draft regulations.
proposals.after: In Dading 29 (1189), under Emperor Zhangzong, the Emperor set forth ten points on official selection and ordered Palace Attendant Helu to instruct the Department of State Affairs to draft regulations.
proposals.reason: 尚书省 is the Department of State Affairs, not a provincial office.

proposals.before: Under Emperor Zhangzong in the twenty-ninth year of Dading, the Emperor, on ten matters of selection and appointment, ordered Palace Attendant Helu to instruct the provincial office to draft regulations.
proposals.after: Under Emperor Zhangzong in the twenty-ninth year of Dading, the Emperor, on ten matters of selection and appointment, ordered Palace Attendant Helu to instruct the Department of State Affairs to draft regulations.
proposals.reason: 尚书省 should be Department of State Affairs, not provincial office.

proposals.before: The provincial ministers proposed reducing three-term promotions to two terms; when vacancies were numerous, officials in their second incomplete term who showed talent and hardship, or those scouted by outer-circuit Punishments Bureaus, could be promoted ahead of schedule.
proposals.after: The ministers of the Department of State Affairs proposed reducing three-term promotions to two terms; when vacancies were numerous, officials in their second incomplete term who showed talent and hardship, or those scouted by outer-circuit Judicial Commissions, could be promoted ahead of schedule.
proposals.reason: 省臣 means ministers of the Shangshu Sheng, not provincial ministers.

proposals.before: The provincial office proposed elevation in rank for verified candidates.
proposals.after: The Department of State Affairs proposed elevation in rank for verified candidates.
proposals.reason: 尚书省 is the Department of State Affairs, not a provincial office.

proposals.before: The provincial office drafted: according to the imperial intent, draft registration with rank elevation.
proposals.after: The Department of State Affairs drafted: according to the imperial intent, draft registration with rank elevation.
proposals.reason: 尚书省 should be rendered Department of State Affairs.

proposals.before: An associate administrator replied: "Self-replacement does not mean immediate succession—it means registering names so that the most frequently nominated can be appointed; this follows the ancient tradition of mutual recommendation from the Zhou Offices."
proposals.after: An associate administrator replied: "Self-replacement does not mean immediate succession—it means registering names so that the most frequently nominated can be appointed; this is the remnant intent of officials yielding to one another under Shun and recommending the worthy in the Zhou Offices."
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits the Chinese reference to Shun (舜官相讓) present in the source.

proposals.before: If the nominee performed well, the recommender gained one rank of seniority.
proposals.after: If the nominee performed well, the original recommending official received a one-rank reduction in required seniority.
proposals.reason: 減一資歷 means waiving one required seniority rank as a reward, not gaining seniority.

proposals.before: If performance was middling, the recommender was promoted or demoted as appropriate.
proposals.after: If performance was middling, the recommender was promoted or appointed as appropriate.
proposals.reason: 升除 means promote or appoint to office; it does not mean demote.

proposals.before: Dading fourth year, standing rule: within one term fault of one tenth or more demotes five persons; two tenths or more demotes ten; three tenths or more demotes fifteen; if there is surplus increase, promotion follows the same; numbers of promotion and demotion not exhausted are applied as offset in the succeeding term.
proposals.after: Dading fourth year, standing rule: within one term fault of one tenth or more demotes five places; two tenths or more demotes ten; three tenths or more demotes fifteen; if there is surplus increase, promotion follows the same; numbers of promotion and demotion not exhausted are applied as offset in the succeeding term.
proposals.reason: In this ranking context 降五人 means demotion by five places in standing, not demoting five persons.

decisions.reason: 天德四年 under Hailing is AD 1152, not 1156; Zhenyuan 2 (s0004) is 1154, so Tiande 4 must precede it.
守令以下小官 includes prefects and magistrates and those below them; 'below the prefect and magistrate level' wrongly excludes 守令.

decisions.reason: 戶部郎中 is a director within the Ministry of Revenue, not the minister heading it. Translating the title is clearer than leaving Langzhong in the idiomatic text.

decisions.reason: 省除 means appointment by the central Department of State Affairs. The worker correctly rejected dismissal but incorrectly called the appointment provincial.
